utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Dane — I’m happy to help with the book club. What did you want to plan?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara — sorry I’m late. Could we pick a book and sort out when we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries at all — let’s pick a book and a meeting time. I’m happy to help narrow it down.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — when’s the next book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the details first, then I’ll tell you the next meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Hana — just let me know when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Noah, have you got enough snacks and tea for book club, or should I bring some?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I probably missed that detail — I think I’ve got some snacks, but tea would be great if you can bring it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ll bring the tea for book club.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still getting my bearings with the book club—what are folks reading this month?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We’re reading a mystery novel this month, but I should check the exact title so I don’t steer you wrong.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No rush — I’m happy to wait for the exact title. I like a good mystery.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are we actually meeting this week, or should I bring my copy next time?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard we’re still on for this week, but I’d double-check with someone in the group just in case.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll check with the group and bring my copy if we’re still on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard this month’s pick is a real page-turner — want me to tell you what I know about it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, Tess — I’d love to hear what it’s about.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard it’s a mystery set in a sleepy little town, with a lot of secrets bubbling under the surface. Folks say it gets twisty fast!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Opal, you should come to book club with us this week — I think you’d really like it! We’re meeting Thursday evening at my place.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds lovely, Quinn — Thursday evening at your place works for me. Just send me the address and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Wonderful — I’ll send you the address right away, and I’m so glad you’re coming!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just to confirm — you’re still okay helping with the book club, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, absolutely — I’m still happy to help with the book club.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely, Bo — I can help get the book club organized if you’d like. Do you have a book in mind yet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Not yet, but I’m open to suggestions — maybe something light and easy to discuss.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can put together a few light, discussion-friendly picks and we can choose one together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll bring it up at the book club and let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik. I’ll be there and keep my notes handy.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll mention it to the group and make sure everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the book club! I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m happy to come along if you remind me when it is.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s this Thursday evening at my place, if that still works for you. I can send the title again too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That still works for me—thank you! Please send the title again, and I’ll mark Thursday evening on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the book club? I’d love to hear what you all are reading this month.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re reading a mystery this month—good enough to keep everyone guessing, apparently.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh nice, I love a good mystery—what’s the title? Maybe I can join and help guess the ending.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club? You should come this week — I’m inviting a few neighbors, and it should be a fun one.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, I might be a little late, but I’d love to stop by if there’s still room.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course—come whenever you can, there’ll be room for you. I’ll save you a spot and let the others know you’re coming.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still deciding if I’ll come, but I’d love to hear what book you’re reading this month.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re reading "The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency" this month, and we meet Tuesday at 7. If you want, I can save you a seat.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds lovely—please save me a seat, and I’ll try to make it Tuesday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make book club work if we keep it after school pickup. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me — how about 4:30? It should give everyone time after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 works for me. I’ll be there after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds fun — I’d love to hear what the book club’s reading this month.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re reading a mystery novel this month, and I’m planning to bring some snacks too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Nice, a mystery sounds perfect for book club — and snacks always help. I’d love to hear which one you picked!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if the book club needs anything, I’ve got a few tools I can lend. What are you all working on?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s kind of you, Gus — I’m just trying to figure out the timing and who’s bringing what before we meet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help with the checklist — I can bring a notepad or a folding table if needed. Just let me know the time and I’ll fit right in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think the book club meets at the community center on Maple Street, right? I can double-check the time if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that sounds right—Maple Street at the community center. If you could double-check the time, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, I’ll check the time and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still meeting for book club on Friday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I think so — let me just check the details first to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — what time and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be happy to help with the book club—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help me track what snacks and supplies we still need for the book club?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help with that. Send me the list of what you already have, and I’ll track the rest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the book club’s meeting again this week — what are they reading now?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I’m not totally sure — I think they changed it again and I missed the update. Maybe I should ask around.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can ask around too and let you know if I hear anything. Seems like they’re keeping us all guessing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, just to confirm — are we still meeting about the book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, we’re still on for this week — I’ll send the details soon!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure. I’ll watch for the details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, nice — did the book club pick the next read yet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet, I think they’re still deciding. I’ll let you know once they settle on one.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — just give me a shout when they decide.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the book club. I’m pretty sure I meant to bring something to it, but I can’t remember what exactly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Maybe a snack or the book itself? If you want, I can help you check the club message.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be great—let’s check the message. I’d hate to show up empty-handed again.
